quickAdd.title: Quick add
quickAdd.intro: Open the add screen in one tap, already filled in. Add &amount=150&cat=transport to the link to pre-fill more.
quickAdd.copyManually: Press and hold the link to copy it
quickAdd.android: After installing the app, press and hold its icon. Drag “Add expense” (or Add income / Transfer) onto the home screen. One tap then opens the add screen.

shortcut.title: iPhone: save from a Shortcut
shortcut.intro: Add an expense from the home screen without opening the app: title, amount, category, then Save. It uses your last-used wallet and needs internet. The entry shows up here after the next sync.
shortcut.signIn: Sign in with Google above to use the iPhone Shortcut.
shortcut.step1: 1. Make your key and copy it.
shortcut.keyNote: The key is shown only once. Making a new key stops the old one.
shortcut.copyManually: Press and hold the key to copy it
shortcut.keyError: Couldn’t make a key. Check the internet and try again.
shortcut.step2: 2. Tap Install Shortcut, then paste the key when the iPhone asks for it.
shortcut.step3: 3. Add the Shortcut to the home screen, the Action Button or Back Tap.

privacy.title: Privacy & terms
privacy.intro: PaiPoisha is a free money tracker. Your money records are yours: we keep only what the app needs to work, and we never sell or share them.
privacy.storeBody: What you type into the app: entries, wallets, categories, budgets and settings. If you sign in with Google, we also get your name, email address and profile photo from Google. PaiPoisha never connects to your bKash, Nagad, Rocket, bank or card accounts, and never asks for their PINs or passwords: you type the amounts yourself.
privacy.whereBody: On your phone, in the browser's storage. If you sign in, a copy is kept safely in the cloud so you can use the app on more than one device and get your data back if you lose your phone. Each account can read only its own data.
privacy.neverBody: No ads, and we never sell your data or share it with anyone. We count page visits anonymously (no cookies, no amounts, nothing that identifies you) to see how the app is used.
privacy.othersBody: We use Google for sign-in, and trusted cloud services to keep your data and run the app. They handle it only to provide this service.
privacy.deleteBody: Signed in: open More → Delete my account and data. Your account and all its data are removed from our servers at once, and from that phone. Not signed in: your data is only on your phone; clearing this site's data or removing the app deletes it.
privacy.contactBody: Questions or problems? <link>Open an issue on GitHub</link>.
privacy.freeBody: PaiPoisha is free to use and is provided as it is, without any guarantee. We do our best to keep your data safe and the app working, but we can't promise it will always be available or free of mistakes.
privacy.notBankBody: PaiPoisha only keeps a record of what you type. It does not hold or move money, and nothing in it is financial advice.
privacy.yoursBody: You are responsible for what you enter and for keeping your Google account and phone secure.
privacy.changesBody: We may update the app, this policy or these terms. When we do, we'll change the date at the top of this page.
